fields.value: | Causal downside | Initiator: flight/OEM or defense-demand weakness and/or cost/supply disruption. First break: fewer/delayed orders or inability to recover costs. Transmission: margin compression plus inventory/receivable cash absorption. Consequence: weaker CFO with continued engineering/capex/interest requirements and less liquidity, then greater refinancing dependence. | Leading: orders/utilization/delivery delays; then gross/operating margins, inventories/receivables and CFO; finally actual accessible liquidity, maturity coverage and financing terms. Missing forecast/cash restrictions prohibit a numeric runway/default date. |

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: | Mitigation and contrary evidence | Disclosed productivity/pricing actions, product breadth, actual historical cash generation and completed financing transactions may absorb stress. Acquisitions could add earnings but also consume cash. | Do not assume cuts, price recovery, synergies, borrowing or sponsor support will occur; require dated evidence of execution, costs and available capacity. |

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: | Revenue durability | Average | Installed-base/replacement logic versus common traffic/defense cycle; confirm actual orders and retention. |

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: | Margin resilience | Average | Historical source operating improvement versus missing price/volume/cost downside bridge. |

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: | Cash conversion | Average | Exact inherited CFO/capex supports historical contribution; acquisitions/distributions and working-capital cycles constrain inference. |

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: | Liquidity buffer | Not Assessable | Accounting cash/available facility are known historical observations; accessible post-event/forward liquidity missing. |

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: | Refinancing capacity | Average, historical only | Completed refinancing versus current market/terms/access and maturity takeout gaps. |

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: | Financial policy | Weak | Documented secured-debt/cash shareholder payout; positive cash/profit evidence does not settle future policy or permissions. |

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: | Revenue | Orders/utilization, OEM delivery schedules, defense awards or product loss change replacement/production cash demand. | No invented numeric trigger; obtain dated operating and customer data. |

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: | EBITDA margin | Realized price/volume/cost and integration-cost bridge, source-definition changes or recurring add-backs alter debt-service earnings quality. | Keep ordinary/operating/As Defined separate; obtain the next financials and CP-1D support. |

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: | Cash conversion | Inventory/receivable build or CFO divergence from operating earnings reduces actual cash available. | Compare like periods and acquisition-adjusted scope; do not subtract interest/tax twice. |

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: | Liquidity | Post-distribution unrestricted cash, facility conditions/LCs and cash forecast determine accessible buffer and first trough. | Critical F1 remains; request cash/access restrictions and dated forecast. |

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: | Leverage | Actual debt reduction versus debt-funded acquisitions/distributions changes claims against cash generation. | Principal/carrying/covenant/lease definitions cannot be mixed; no ratio to an invented normalized base. |

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: | Refinancing | Dated funding commitments/terms and approaching contractual/fiscal maturity dates change takeout dependence. | Historical available revolver and unused capacity are not assured takeout cash. |

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: | Shareholder action | New distribution, buyback, acquisition, support or legal change changes cash allocation and creditor control. | Use documented actions and actual terms, not assumed sponsor willingness or ownership. |

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: | Sector conditions | Traffic, airline economics, OEM supply chains, defense budgets, certification/export or technology change the causal operating chain. | Current source gives mechanisms; date any external evidence separately and do not assert later outcomes. |

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: | G1/G2 / Material | Specific156 cells and five statement layouts checked; broader glyph/visual coverage limited. | Keep source/line references and target uncertain cells; all analysts and delivery preserve actual scope. |

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: | G3 / Material | Retained historical annual pack; no latest/current or2024 availability-date certification. | Obtain dated current sources for a current decision; do not relabel the historical run. |

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: | G4/F4 / Material | Missing quarter, market/agency/portfolio/forward inputs and complete prior balance/definition observations. | CP-1B/CP-1C/CP-2D/CP-2G/CP-2H/CP-3 and delivery must not invent their positive conclusions. |

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: | F1 / Critical | No operative contracts/current covenant certificate/unrestricted cash or supported access/cash forecast. | CP-4 legal terms/usage and CP-2D/CP-3C dated accessible cash/funding are required before a positive new capacity/takeout claim. |

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: | A1 / Critical | Actual beneficial ownership/control/proxy/related-party/support information not supplied. | CP-1A/CP-4/CP-6 require the actual records; no sponsor or individual judgment by inference. |

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: | F2 / Material | Finance-lease narrative wording versus explicit current/long schedule conflict, already in total debt. | Preserve exact source conflict and avoid double-counting; clarify if classification matters. |

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: | F3 / Material | Reconciliation of issuer adjustments does not establish sustainable earnings quality. | CP-1D recurrence/normalization support; no adjusted cash-capacity conclusion. |

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: | A2 / Material | No realized synergy or post-subsequent-event accessible cash evidence. | Obtain dated integration and cash/access updates; no projected outcome represented as fact. |
